quarterly_data.signal: Project Crucible (Tennessee integrated smelter for critical minerals, non-ferrous metals and semiconductor sulfuric acid) permitting: Korea Zinc said the US Department of War completed the Final Environmental Assessment under NEPA on the 11th (US local time) and issued a Finding of No Significant Impact (FONSI). The company says the Final EA is the reference for the further federal and state permits - the Department of War uses it for its financing-support decision and the Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA) for its power-infrastructure support decision - and that the individual construction and operating permits will now proceed in stages. In May the project became the first FAST-41 project designated by the Federal Permitting Improvement Steering Council after its MOU with the State of Tennessee.
quarterly_data.figure: Final EA with FONSI completed on the 11th (US local time); FAST-41 designation in May
